name: BeemBridge
subtitle: File Transfer Without Walls
description: Most file transfer tools force a compatibility check before you send anything. AirDrop works only inside Apple. Quick Share skips iOS and macOS entirely. Beembridge removes that check - install it once on any device and it works with every other device running Beembridge, across all major platforms.

Beyond the local network, Beembridge supports peer-to-peer transfers between devices on entirely different networks, without routing any file data through a server. A browser mode lets recipients receive files without installing anything. Currently in beta, with a commercial model planned for online transfers.
technologies: Rust: Desktop application and core networking layer
roles: Built the full-stack desktop and mobile application, from UI to core networking logic.
Implemented cross-network P2P using STUN-based device discovery and WebRTC for the browser transfer mode.
Designed and managed the cloud infrastructure and CI/CD deployment pipeline.
Architected the product split between the open-source local app and the closed-source online platform.
